_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored), fill in, then run: python tools/build.py. Nothing here is secret: every client is public. Reference: docs/configuration.md
_workspaces_root: Where each user's workspaces (local clones) go. ~ is the user's profile folder; %VAR% works too. Avoid folders synced by OneDrive and anything under AppData (Claude Desktop may redirect it). See docs/configuration.md.
_diagnostics: true adds diagnostic tools, validation skills and a hook log. Keep false for users.
_support_email: Where users send what the connector cannot resolve on its own. Optional, but without it users get the report and no e-mail link.
_specialist: How the specialist works. Languages: documentation and specifications, and code (defaults to the documentation language); technical terms stay in English. Code is written where a project declares it (.eunomai/project.toml on its main branch), or anywhere when free_development is on (allowed_technologies limits it; empty means any). See docs/configuration.md
_organization: What the specialist should know about the organization (what it does, systems that already exist), and which of its skills to use for what. These come before anything personal in a user's session. See docs/configuration.md
organization_context: Example Corp makes industrial equipment. Existing systems: an ERP for orders and stock, and an HR system for people and absences.

organization_skills.use_for: the look of web pages and applications
